selection_stage1: E0 six entries TRAIN only, primary RAW at0.40% cost, n>=100; top2 by mean price_costR then totalR then lexicographic ID. If negative still diagnostic, not a profitability claim. Commit selection before TEST/exit run.
selection_stage2: Only five new exits on two selected entries => max16 unique entry/exit combos, two cost views each. Choose one final pair by TRAIN same criterion and freeze before TEST. All evaluated variants including failures published.
regimes: BTC r24 from closed nativeH1 available atdecision; <=-3% down, >=+3% up, rest sideways, missing UNKNOWN; n<40 marked SMALL_SAMPLE
multiple_testing: max16 actual configs; no tuning on regimes or TEST; clustered sensitivity/concentration descriptive, no independent significance claim on EXPOSED data
